name: Quality-Aware Release Selection
changes: Makes the configured Quality Profile rank the primary ordering key for safe/eligible Interactive Search and Continuous Automation candidates.
Uses a bounded 0-10 relative file-size preference only among accepted releases in the same quality tier for the same target, providing a conservative bitrate-quality signal.
Reduces the 24-hour indexer reliability adjustment from an 80-point cross-tier override to a maximum 12-point within-tier tie-breaker.
Shows profile rank, selection score, file-size bonus, and indexer reliability adjustment directly in Interactive Search and Why this release explanations.
Preserves all strict title/episode/edition safety checks, blacklist behavior, profile minimum/maximum size rejection rules, and v3.6.45 library-scan progress.
regression_guards: A valid 1080p WEB-DL ranks above a valid 720p WEB-DL in the 1080p Balanced profile even when the 1080p indexer has the maximum reliability penalty and the 720p release has a custom-format bonus.
Within the same profile tier and otherwise-equal scoring, a materially larger file receives a bounded size bonus and ranks above the smaller candidate.
Indexer reliability penalty is capped at 12 and cannot alter the higher-order Quality Profile rank.
The 30 strict TV identity cases, non-destructive Library Integrity review, diagnostics compaction, client-disconnect handling, and asynchronous library-scan guards remain mandatory.
v3.6.41 fail-soft Downloads snapshot and v3.6.20+ serialized private-SAB transport remain unchanged.
